source_resources.title: SciPy numerical derivative reference
source_resources.author: SciPy Developers
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: derivative API: finite differences, step-size iteration, tolerances
source_resources.permission_basis: Link only; all learner-facing explanations and examples are original.
source_resources.prerequisites: Python arithmetic and the definition of a derivative
source_resources.selection_rationale: Documents numerical differentiation as an approximation with finite step sizes and stopping criteria.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Requires network access for the current hosted API page.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The local Day 18 tables and pure-Python snippets reproduce the relevant finite-difference behavior without SciPy.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Array-oriented gradient estimation on sampled grids; the SciPy derivative reference matches the pointwise finite-difference helper the exercises implement.
Symbolic rather than numerical differentiation; useful for exact cross-checks but not the finite-difference practice target.
